notes.title: Online Mode
notes.content:
The new [b]Online Mode[/b] allows you to play online with your Steam friends that own the game, up to 8. 
Simply invite your friends, and the friends of your friends, from the character selection, it's that simple!

But there is more:
[list]
[*] 2 new playable characters, [b]black and white[/b] (Bolt & Walt)
[*] 1 new level, [b]Hell[/b]
[*] 1 new game mode, [b]ColorBlind[/b]
[*] improvements on the readability of levels
[*] bugs fixing
[/list]

notes.title: Patch note 12th december 2021
notes.content:
Hello! 
Thank you so much to everyone who has supported us so far, whether through wishlisting, buying, or playing OctaFight, or even giving us feedbacks and bug reports.

Here are the changes:
- You can now skip the splash screen by pressing any button
- The custom bomb selection bug is fixed

Have fun!
